name: Open Facilitator Codex Harness Adapter
description: Installs the Codex harness worker (OpenAI codex CLI stand-in) as a self-contained Node bundle plus a supervisor unit that attaches it to the team Gateway's child socket. The codex CLI itself is assumed present in the base image (override with requireCli:false). Install order is irrelevant: units carry numeric prefixes and every Feature writes distinct files.

configPath.description: Worker config the unit starts with; WORKER_CONFIG env overrides at runtime.

requireCli.description: Fail the install when the codex CLI is not on PATH. Set false to install the worker bundle without the native CLI present.
